name: Overview — all 24 samples
notes:
This overview combines 24 regional ENCODE H3K27ac tracks with condition-matched bulk RNA-seq across forebrain, heart, and limb at four embryonic stages. Tracks are grouped by tissue and stage, and signal scales to the current view. Explore the ten-megabase Ascl1 landscape freely; Included regions marks the available data, including three one-megabase windows used by later bookmarks.

Expression colors are gene-wise z-scores of log2(mean TPM + 1) across the 12 tissue-stage conditions. Zero is a gene's average in this panel; blue is below average and red is above average. Each value is the mean of two condition-matched bulk RNA-seq replicates and is shared by both H3K27ac rows for that condition—the assays are not sample-paired.

The following bookmarks zoom into individual regulatory examples and reduce or regroup the sample set when that makes the tissue contrast easier to see.

Sources: [ENCODE](https://www.encodeproject.org/) (Bing Ren H3K27ac; Barbara Wold RNA-seq), [Gorkin et al. (2020)](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-020-2093-3) (chromatin atlas, reporter results, and element annotations), and [He et al. (2020)](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-020-2536-x) (expression context). Exact accessions, provenance, the reproducible workflow, and rights information are available in the [dataset recipe](https://github.com/genome-spy/genomespy-dataset-recipes/tree/main/recipes/encode-mouse-fetal-development-mm10).

name: Ascl1 — forebrain at E12.5
notes:
Both E12.5 forebrain replicates show stronger H3K27ac across the five highlighted predictions than heart or limb. *Ascl1* and *Foxg1* expression reinforce the forebrain identity of these samples.

The highlighted intervals are published enhancer–*Ascl1* predictions from Gorkin et al. (2020). They are computational predictions, not proof that these intervals regulate *Ascl1*.

name: Ascl1 prediction 3 — chromatin and expression
notes:
The brush marks the published interval Ascl1 prediction 3. GenomeSpy calculates its weighted-mean H3K27ac signal separately for every displayed row and plots that value against the *Ascl1* expression z-score. To explore another interval, create a new selection and then generate a new plot from it—either directly or after deriving a new metadata attribute.

Each pair of H3K27ac replicates has independent signal values but shares one condition-level RNA-seq mean. The points are therefore not 24 independent paired observations. Read the plot as an exploratory comparison of compatible chromatin and expression patterns, not as a correlation test or evidence that the selected interval regulates *Ascl1*.

name: mEN978 — heart reporter element
notes:
Both E12.5 heart replicates show a strong H3K27ac peak at mEN978, while forebrain and limb remain low on the same scale. *Tnnt2* and *Nkx2-5* expression identify the heart samples.

In Gorkin et al. (2020), mEN978 drove heart reporter activity in 5 of 8 embryos. This supports activity of the tested construct but does not establish an endogenous target gene.

name: mEN918 — limb reporter element
notes:
Both E12.5 limb replicates show a strong H3K27ac peak at mEN918, while forebrain and heart remain low. *Hand2*, *Prrx1*, and *Myog* expression identify the limb samples.

In Gorkin et al. (2020), mEN918 drove limb reporter activity in 4 of 4 embryos and somite activity in 3 of 4. The result is not limb-exclusive and does not identify an endogenous target gene.

name: mEN886 — tissue identity across stages
notes:
Across the developmental panel, mEN886 shows a clear forebrain-associated H3K27ac pattern. Compare the stages vertically, but do not assume that the signal follows a simple increasing or decreasing trajectory.

[Gorkin et al. (2020)](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-020-2093-3) reported neural reporter activity for mEN886. The overlapping *Ckb*-linked interval is a separate computational prediction; neither annotation proves endogenous *Ckb* regulation.
